Towhid Hridoy to Wiaan Mulder, 1 run, fifth Test century for Wiaan Mulder! He gets a standing ovation from the spectators, his teammates and the coaches. Gets there with a gentle nudge through the leg-side and takes off his helmet to celebrate the milestone. Has been a terrific knock. In fact, all the batsmen have put up a solid batting performance for the Proteas
Towhid Hridoy to Marco Jansen, FOUR, flicked uppishly towards deep mid-wicket and he manages to beat the fielder's dive in the deep. 100-run stand up!
Towhid Hridoy to Marco Jansen, 2 runs, cheeky. Plays this late, steering it to third man for a couple of runs

Towhid Hridoy to Marco Jansen, 1 run, slapped right back at the bowler who gets his hands to it. Fails to stop the ball though. Would have been a run-out chance had that hit the stumps at the bowler's end
Towhid Hridoy to Wiaan Mulder, THATS OUT!! Caught!!

Towhid Hridoy to Wiaan Mulder, out Caught by Jaker Ali!! South Africa have lost a wicket with stumps around the corner. Flatter through the air outside off, Wiaan Mulder goes for a cut, and gets thick outside edge. A sharp catch by the keeper and that's the end of a superb knock. Walks back to the pavilion in the last over of the day.. Walks back to a standing ovation by everyone present at the venue. Wiaan Mulder c Jaker Ali b Towhid Hridoy 100(178) [4s-12 6s-2]
Simon Harmer, right handed bat, comes to the crease
Towhid Hridoy to Simon Harmer, no run, Simon Harmer safely negotiates the last ball of the day. Nudged to mid-wicket and that shall be Stumps on Day 2
